question: Does the frozen 1.25 reverse-interface calibration transfer to later temporal-v13/iswas-v12 constructions without refitting?
scope: Temporal v13 is genuinely fresh to the gain diagnostic. Is/was v12 is a later construction bank but was previously opened by another program, so it is corroborative rather than globally sealed evidence.

predictions.pred_a_authority_population_finiteness_a: All authorities/builders match, both capability gates pass, support has 48 sites, all values are finite, and exactly 25 forwards execute.
predictions.pred_b_gain125_reverse_behavior_transfer: Every temporal/iswas cross-fit behavior projection is in [0.90,1.10] with worst target residual at most 0.15.
predictions.pred_c_reverse_coordinates_remain_accura: Every unscaled compiled coordinate projection is at least 0.75 and mean coordinate residual is at most 0.20.
predictions.pred_d_gain125_controls_remain_selective: Both cross-fits have control margin RMS at most 0.10, median full-vocabulary KL at most 0.02, and flip fraction at most 0.05.
predictions.pred_e_crossfit_is_stable: Per-task behavior projections differ by at most 0.05 and minimum coordinate projections differ by at most 0.05 across fits.

decision: All five predictions establish a frozen scalar calibration on a genuinely fresh temporal family and corroborative later is/was family. Failure localizes calibration by task/site; it does not reopen support pruning.
